fields.description: Issue features an editorial attacking publisher John S. Knight and criticizing Miami Beach police practices that target unemployed and destitute visitors as vagrants. Reports on a Chicago printers' strike settlement and its implications for Miami newspaper labor negotiations. Includes detailed coverage of Miami police enforcement tactics, including alleged entrapment in a Lenox Hotel prostitution raid and use of a police stenographer to induce horse-bet taking, along with city court outcomes. Additional local items address a rise in automobile break-ins, downtown business closures and high rents amid recession concerns, opposition to building a fire station on a school playground, and commentary on gambling/bookmaking and racetrack policy.
